instruction.text: Entscheide, um welche Zeitform es sich handelt.

atoms.a: Her father read the newspaper this morning.
His mother has been a reporter for 17 years.
Loreto had watched the news on TV before they had lunch.
Azura was writing an article for the school paper.
Nadira has been dreaming of becoming a politician for three years.
Iwan had been participating in the debating club, before he joined another extracurricular activity.

instruction.text: Schreibe das jeweilige Verb in der genannten Zeitform in die Lücke.

atoms.b: The students ((participated)) in a mock election to learn about the voting system.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>mock election</voice> bedeutet Probewahl<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>voting system</voice> bedeutet Wahlsystem

atoms.b: Elara ((has_joined)) a political party and became an active member.

hint.text:
political party – politische Partei
active member – aktives Mitglied
hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>political party</voice> bedeutet politische Partei<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>active member</voice> bedeutet aktives Mitglied

atoms.b: She ((had_given)) it a lot of thought, before she voted for the first time in a local election.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to vote</voice> bedeutet wählen<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>local election</voice> bedeutet Kommunalwahl

atoms.b: Begüm ((was_taking)) part in a discussion on a political issue when she saw her friend.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>political issue</voice> bedeutet politische Angelegenheit

atoms.b: They ((have_been_supporting)) a petition for a vegan lunch menu at their school all morning.
They ((had_been_learning)) about democracy for a few weeks before they took an exam on it in school.
